name: How long does it typically take to complete a second-story addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to complete a second-story addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a second-story addition can vary significantly based on the project's scope, design complexity, and material availability. On average, a project can take anywhere from 6 to 12 months, including design, permitting, and construction. Factors like weather delays or unforeseen structural issues can extend this timeframe. Hometelligent Inc. provides a detailed project schedule upfront, helping clients in areas like Berkeley and Dublin understand the stages and estimated duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Completion time for a second-story addition typically ranges from 6 to 12 months, varying by scope and complexity.
